resources.string: Shown when code highlighting is available on this device.
Everything else about an export is chosen each time you share a note.

Low-latency ink paints the pen’s ink straight into the frame the screen is showing — that is what makes it feel instant. A few panels don’t hand that over cleanly, and there the ink can flicker or fall behind the nib. Turn it off on those and every stroke goes through the ordinary canvas.
